caveat: Single institution. The five features of the co-creation process come from the research team's own thematic analysis, so check how practitioner ownership was evidenced rather than asserted.
title: Sustainable curriculum innovation through educational design research in conservatoire education
why: Four years of practitioner-led educational design research in a Dutch conservatoire, producing a shared curriculum lens, two embedded modules and transferable design principles. The nearest published template for your own design-based work with teacher teams.
